messages:
emily: quick check from the all-hands Q&A — consolidating reliability follow-ups. RCA here: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-87 :link:  Please add any missing owners/ETAs.

sre-bot: Timeline & logs uploaded to incident tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-03-20-87. Tags: service:inference, severity:sev2.

raj: thanks emily. who is owning the routing fallback follow-up? we need an owner before EOD to schedule a canary test.

linda: I can pick routing fallback. will do a runbook update and small canary tomorrow. ETA EOD 03/22. adding to the RCA page.

tom: quick question — do we have SLO change requests recorded? The spike was mostly tail latency from cold KV cache misses.

emily: not yet, tom. action: @jordan-lead to propose SLO amendment by next week. jordan, can you confirm?

jordan-lead: I will draft an SLO proposal (latency p99) and share in #eng-sre by 03/25. linking to the proposal doc shortly.

cassie: for playbook: can we add the short remediation checklist? small script to rebuild KV on affected nodes. snippet:
```
# rebuild kv cache on node
kubectl exec -n infra kv-sync -- /usr/local/bin/kv_rebuild --shard=all
```
I'll PR the playbook after tests.

raj: is there a risk of cost bump if we keep the cache warm? need tradeoff note in RCA.

linda: good point. I'll add cost estimate: ~+$2k/month if we provision N extra GB. adding to RCA under 'tradeoffs'.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-21T22:10 by emily: rolled inference-routing-fallback v2 -> prod. Link: https://redwood.internal/deploys/4621

sre-bot: Follow-up checklist created and owners assigned: routing fallback -> linda, SLO proposal -> jordan-lead, playbook PR -> cassie. See RCA action table.

emily: perfect. last ask — whoever lands the playbook PR, ping #eng-oncall so we can schedule a 30m dry-run. :thumbsup:

tom: adding to my calendar. thanks all.

linda: done. PR ready for review, will ping once CI passes.

cassie: CI passed, PR up. @emily please review when you have a minute.

emily: reviewing now, should merge today. thanks everyone :tada:
